method.terminal_rule: Every ordinal receives an evidence-backed disposition; implementation revisions are lineage-deduplicated and papers/docs retain provenance without multiplying implementation credit.
method.claim_rule: Commit-message metrics, paper claims and audit percentages remain source-reported unless separately reproduced. Neuroscience labels are treated as implementation names/analogies, not biological equivalence.

DEPLOYMENT_RUNTIME_RECOVERY.policy: IMPLEMENTATION_AND_NEGATIVE_RESULT_LINEAGE; fresh-install/runtime/config/service-topology failures define reusable acceptance tests; successive fixes do not multiply earned-work credit.

ONLINE_LEARNING_STABILITY_INTEGRITY.policy: MECHANISM_AND_FAILURE_LINEAGE; learning claims require schema-versioned persistence, recorded transitions, mask/policy integrity and observed write counters.

THOUGHT_QUALITY_REWARD_PROXY.policy: IMPLEMENTATION_LINEAGE; textual quality/agency filters are style/reward proxies, not proof of agency or cognition.

COGNITIVE_CONTROL_SENSOR_EMBODIMENT.policy: ARCHITECTURE_LINEAGE; preserve functional mechanisms and failures while requiring causal ablation. Neuroscience/embodiment naming does not itself establish biological or phenomenal equivalence.

GPU_RESOURCE_ARBITRATION.policy: OPERATIONAL_SCHEDULING_LINEAGE; historical fixed idle gate is evidence of contention, not a required current constant.

FEATURE_LIVENESS_FAILURE.policy: NEGATIVE_RESULT_VALUE; code/module presence is insufficient without behavioral heartbeat/output evidence.

DOCS_RESEARCH_FRAMING.policy: PROVENANCE_AND_HYPOTHESIS_LINEAGE; papers/observations are not implementation credit and stated empirical claims remain source-reported.

cross_stage_feedback.rule: No online/adaptive learner may report training merely because a train loop ran. Require schema-versioned migrations, accepted transition/example counts, rejected-write counts, model-version identity and durable write receipts. Reproduce k207/k208/k211 silent/missing-training-data failures.

Every learned visual/sensor signal should preserve self-caused/external/unknown attribution with confidence. k210 shows why aggregate resource/sensor changes cannot safely be interpreted without source identity; heuristic attribution must remain marked uncertain.

Replay k200/k203. Scoring phrases such as 'so I will' may improve style but cannot count as agency. Agency acceptance requires a state transition, selected goal/action, effect receipt and later outcome/revision evidence.
Reproduce k208: aborted/never-started sessions and failed tools must emit explicit failure reason and must not create positive experience/memory records.

Use the k222 criterion as a controlled test hypothesis: with identical persistent architecture/history and matched tasks, swap underlying model and measure which state trajectories/behaviors persist versus diverge. Do not assume model independence in advance.

For body/proprioception mechanisms inherited from k210/k215/k216, lesion or permute body state while holding prompt/task constant and require measurable downstream action/attention differences; narrative mention alone is insufficient.

Run fresh target-OS installation plus restart and partial-capability cases. Reproduce historical stale-venv, absent-service restart cascade, interpreter/dependency, resource-limit and optional-network failures from k196-k201.
A subsystem cannot PASS on module/import/service presence. Require expected output/event heartbeat and branch exercise; k213 had two small state bugs that blocked every idle thought.

Reproduce k218 wrong-process singleton failure. One authoritative mutable state owner or explicit transaction semantics must be enforced; helper processes may not instantiate competing heavyweight state owners accidentally.

Historical k212 shows background cognition can starve interactive work. Replace fixed silence thresholds with measured priority/resource budgets and verify interactive tail latency under concurrent autonomous cognition.

Treat k193 as a replay target, not proof: reconstruct the event timeline and intervene on shared spatial-state/re-entry links. The causal claim survives only if intention→action coupling disappears under targeted lesions and returns when restored.
